articles.title: Midterm elections could jolt stocks if Democrats sweep Congress
articles.description: Wall Street weighs how the 2026 midterms could affect stocks, Treasury yields, artificial intelligence, energy prices, banks, defense and healthcare.

articles.title: Binance’s net inflows turn positive at $2.3B as withdrawals expand

articles.title: Bitcoin steadies after dip to $76,300 as ETF outflows and midterm elections weigh on crypto

articles.title: Liquid Network Restores Full Bitcoin Backing Two Months After $320M Exploit

articles.title: Liquid’s bitcoin IOUs are fully backed again after a $320 million exploit

articles.title: France postpones 2027 budget vote, crypto exit-tax proposals scrapped
